reasoning: The icon literally depicts a picture-in-picture screen layout (a rectangular frame with a solid top-right inset box) combined with a clock badge at the bottom right. In a task manager, users will read it either literally as scheduled/timed picture-in-picture video or more broadly as 'screen time' and display sleep timers, though at list size it can be confused with a folder-history icon.
